title: Conic Sections and Implicit Relations
description: Find the locus of points exactly 5 units from (-2,3) and determine its x- and y-intercepts.
outcomes: Define loci by distance conditions and derive the standard circle equation.
Derive and analyze parabolas as points equidistant from a focus and directrix.
Analyze ellipses from constant-sum distance and standard equations.
Analyze hyperbolas from constant-difference distance and standard equations.
Convert general quadratic relations to standard conic form by completing squares.
Classify translated conics and recover all geometric features from standard form.
Identify point, line, pair-of-lines, empty-set, and other degenerate quadratic relations.
Use eccentricity to compare circles, ellipses, parabolas, and hyperbolas.
Solve and interpret intersections of lines, circles, parabolas, ellipses, and hyperbolas.
Construct and critique conic models in reflection, orbit, architecture, and navigation settings.
sources: University of Washington Precalculus, conic problem sets
